# Romania

[global-law](../) / Romania

## Completeness, checked against the official sources (2026-11-12)

| Constitution | Main codes | National law | Law-making regions | Case law |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| held | 100% | 100% | not applicable | 75% |

Broad but uneven: romania-law holds the Constitution, all 8 essential codes with amendment history, about 58,000 laws, OUG, OG and HG, 23,509 CCR decisions and the ÎCCJ's RIL/HP rulings, but only 6% of the primary acts have more than one version, 13,135 amended acts are held only as first published, and every essential code was last checked between June and October 2026 (its own freshness file marks them stale). The README's 97% / 81% / 69% chart is a weighted average of the repository's own targets, with numerators that include amending acts and metadata-only records; by text held, local acts are 0.6%, not 69%.

Shares are of what exists, not of what each repository says it holds; estimates are marked, with their method in [data/completeness.json](../data/completeness.json).
